rows.medi_said: inti bitcoin, bitcoini ayana?
rows.amal_said: لا، كنتي. You were. I said I was.
rows.why: He asks 'were you sick?' with kunt (my form, engine wrote bitcoin) and Amal says no, the you-feminine form is كنتي; I said 'I was' so I use kunt.

rows.medi_said: قـ-ق-قطرت ... قطرت أو اشتريت. I chose and bought.
rows.amal_said: اشتريت. Or you could put an "e" in the beginning، اختارت.
rows.why: He means 'I chose' and says قطرت five times; Amal keeps answering اشتريت then gives اختارت ('put an e in the beginning'); could be partly a dropped-vowel/خ sound slip (S4) but she supplied the word.
rows.english: I chose (and bought a lot of new rugs)

rows.medi_said: ما يـال-- ما بيعلموا كتير ... بيعمل ... كتير. he doesn't do a lot.
rows.why: He means 'works a lot' and uses بيعمل (does); Amal asks 'what do you mean?' then recasts with بيشتغل after he offers شغل/اشتغل.
rows.english: He doesn't work much (my uncle is retired)

rows.medi_said: وحدة اليوم. ... Is it وحدة اليوم أو
rows.amal_said: No. ... What's one؟ ... واحد. What's of؟ ... من. What's the days؟
rows.why: 'One of the days' needs من + plural (واحد من الأيام); he said وحدة اليوم, Amal says No and walks him word by word to the right phrase.

rows.medi_said: does backward turn into كلنا؟ ... كلنا؟ كلنا؟
rows.why: He asks if past 'we ate' is كلنا; Amal says No and gives أكلنا (past needs the verb's alif + ending); he says 'that's right'.

rows.medi_said: yeah. كل اليوم.
rows.chat: akalna fi mat3am mu5talef kul yoam
rows.why: 'Every day' is kul + noun with no el-; he said كل اليوم (all the day), Amal says كل and he fixes to كل يوم.

rows.medi_said: What was the other word? ... the other word was هدف.
rows.why: He is searching for 'motivation' (has حافظ/حافز) and offers هدف (goal); Amal supplies دافع (sheet: motive / motivation | Daafe3).

rows.medi_said: أنا مشتاق، مشتاق، مش شجاع.
rows.why: He means 'motivated/encouraged' and says مشتاق then مش شجاع (not brave); Amal gives متشجع (sheet: motivated | Mitshajje3); engine may have heard mitshaje3 as مش شجاع.
rows.english: I am motivated (to work a lot)

rows.medi_said: إحنا، اه، بنستعمل، بنستعمل صديق من العيلة.
rows.amal_said: شو قصدك بنستعمل؟ So تستعمل is to use. You said we use. ... We're working with.
rows.why: He means 'we're using/hiring a family friend' with بنستعمل (use); Amal asks what he means, explains it is 'use', gives 'working with', and he says بنشتغل مع.
rows.english: we're working with a family friend

rows.medi_said: صديق من العيلة. ... or do I say صديقة عيلة؟ عيلة؟ عيلتي؟
rows.amal_said: صدّقت عيلتي. (= صديق عيلتي) ... Or صديق عائلتي / صديق العائلة
rows.why: Idafa: friend + owner with no min/el- on the first word; he says 'friend from the family', then offers variants, Amal answers صديق عيلتي / صديق العائلة.

rows.medi_said: I need to learn hope ... أنا بدي...
rows.why: He says he keeps wanting to say 'I hope' and starts with أنا بدي (I want); Amal supplies بتمنى.

rows.medi_said: I don't know how to say front, do I? ... Would you guys say daher?
rows.why: He asks how to say 'front' and Amal gives قدام (sheet: in front of | Quddaam).

rows.medi_said: راح نتغير. ... راح-- what? راح نت-نتغير. We're going...
rows.amal_said: We will change. We will be changed.
rows.why: He wants 'we will change (the store front)' but says the get-X form نتغير (we get changed); Amal says 'We will be changed' and he fixes to راح نغير (sheet: i get changed | bat8ayyar vs i change | ba8ayyer).
rows.english: we will change (the front of the shop)

rows.medi_said: الـ-- أ-أدام الـ محل
rows.why: He starts with الـ before قدام; Amal says 'No الـ first' (قدام + owner is idafa, first word never takes el-); he explains he thought 'the front' needs el-.

rows.medi_said: راح نستعمل تحت الـ محل، uh, لا الـ
rows.amal_said: تحت is under. What's behind؟ أو ورا. ... ورا.
rows.why: He means 'behind/back of the store' and says تحت (under); Amal says 'تحت is under, what's behind? ورا' (sheet: behind | Wara).

rows.medi_said: أنا، أنا بحمس.
rows.why: He wants 'I'm excited' and says the make-X verb (I excite); Amal says No and gives the state word متحمس.

rows.medi_said: I don't know how to say the change. Would it be مكير? Do you guys have a word for the change, a noun?
rows.why: He asks for the noun 'the change'; Amal hints with the verb إنت غيرت and he gets الـ تغيير, she says أها.

rows.medi_said: قامة ... Is it قامة؟ Is that قام؟
rows.why: He means 'dark green' and says قامة; Amal gives غام / غامقة (sheet: dark (color) | 8aameq); could be only the hard-غ sound slip (S4), but he asks whether it is a word and she supplies it.

rows.medi_said: آدي السترة.
rows.amal_said: بتتذكر شو يعني فترة؟ ... فترة is period of time.
rows.why: He repeats her 'هذي الفترة' as 'السترة' (jacket-like word, engine or misheard), she asks if he remembers what فترة means and he does not.

rows.medi_said: مش بنحتاج jacket.
rows.why: A verb is negated with ma, not mish; Amal says just 'ما.' and he repeats ما بنحتاج jacket.

rows.medi_said: قبل الـ، uh, قبل الـ آدي الدرس.
rows.why: Lesson (درس) is masculine so it takes هذا; he said hadi (engine آدي) and Amal says هذا, he repeats هذا الدرس.

rows.medi_said: كلمات أر، uh, عرس و، وو، uh, مختلف جديد-- جدد، مختلفين جدد.
rows.why: Words (كلمات) are things, so the adjectives would be feminine singular مختلفة جديدة; Amal does not react (she moves on to 'what do we have for the wedding').

rows.medi_said: هم اللي تنين. ... Is it أ-أ-أرسنا؟
rows.why: He cannot remember the word for bride and groom together (says 'the two of them' and 'ar-sana') and Amal gives عرسان; his أرسان is a dropped ع (S4).

rows.medi_said: خطبة is engagement. خطيب، uh- خاطب and خاطبة are fiancé.
rows.why: Sheet: fiancé | 5ateeb | خطيب, fiancée | خطيبة, my fiancée | خطيبتي; he says خاطب / خاطبة (and خاطبتي at 37:52) and Amal does not correct aloud (her chat later writes 5atibti); engine may have written it.

rows.medi_said: For her-- Eid is like holiday, right? Or like--
rows.why: Amal asked what they wear 'في إيدهم' (on their hands); he heard عيد (holiday) and asked, she says No, إيد, then إيديهم and he gets 'her hand'.

rows.medi_said: هي ما، ما كانت، ما كانت تجوزني.
rows.chat: heyye ma kaanat ra7 tetjawwazni abel 3ashar sneen
rows.why: 'She wouldn't have married me' = كانت راح + the verb; he left out راح and the verb ending form, Amal recasts; he then says هي ما را تجوزني.

rows.medi_said: do you guys say واشي? ... I was wild ... azar? What does azar mean?
rows.amal_said: وحش، لا وحش is like for animals. ... كنت أزعر؟ أزعر. It's like bad boyish
rows.why: He asks how to say 'I was wild'; his واشي is not a word, Amal rejects وحش (animals) and gives أزعر.
rows.english: I was wild / a bad boy

rows.medi_said: دولات، دولات
rows.amal_said: No, do you wanna say one country or countries؟ ... صح معناها دول.
rows.why: Plural of دولة (sheet: country | Dawle) is دول; he invented دولات and Amal says No and gives دول.

rows.medi_said: راح أزيد، هنين غرفة، غرفة نوم.
rows.why: 'Two bedrooms' uses the dual ending on the noun (غرفتين نوم); he said 'ithnain ghurfa' (engine هنين), Amal says No and gives غرفتين.

rows.medi_said: أنا بمنى، أنا راح، أنا راح بتمنى. I will wish now.
rows.amal_said: بتمنى. No. ... I asked you قبل العرس أني said أنا بتمنى, so it works.
rows.why: He wraps 'I hope' in راح and keeps the b- after it; Amal says بتمنى then No and explains the plain أنا بتمنى works.

rows.medi_said: عندي ثلاث مشاري AI لـ محل، لـ محل، لـ محلي.
rows.why: 'For my shop' needs the owner ending on the noun; he said لـ محل, Amal says لا, he fixes to لـ محلي and she says Yes.

rows.medi_said: Is it darib?
rows.amal_said: Yes، بس make it feminine. ... ضريبة.
rows.why: Sheet: tax | Dareebe | ضريبة; he recalls the masculine darib, Amal says make it feminine and gives ضريبة.

rows.medi_said: I am happy. Ana basboot. Ana
rows.why: He means 'I am happy' and says basboot, then mazboot; Amal says No and hints 'mab-', he lands on mabsut (her chat writes mabsoot).

rows.medi_said: Ana mabsut, enno khalasit, dari batni.
rows.amal_said: ‫م، fix it. ... First it has its plural.
rows.why: 'My taxes' needs the plural ضرايب before the owner ending; he used the singular dariba + ni, Amal says fix it, first it has its plural.

rows.medi_said: Uh, darayibni, darayibni.
rows.why: A noun takes -i (my) not -ni (verb object ending); Amal says 'No n', he says darayibi, that's right.

rows.medi_said: Uh, kul il darayib. Ibi kul il, right?
rows.amal_said: All my. ... كل الضرايب بس كل ضرايبي.
rows.why: Asked for 'all my taxes' he says kul il darayib (all the taxes); Amal gives كل ضرايبي (kul + owner ending, no el-) and he repeats kul darayibi.

rows.medi_said: Um, so mishfi or mafi ashia, uh, ashia wadfeen.
rows.amal_said: واضحين. بس you're saying not clear. ... So what do I say before واضحين؟
rows.why: 'Nothing is not clear' needs مش before the adjective; he left it out, Amal asks what goes before واضحين and he says Mish wadfeen.
rows.english: there is nothing that isn't clear

rows.medi_said: مشروع المفضل. ... I'm saying مشروع المفضل.
rows.amal_said: Did you put ال first or no؟ ... No. You would say مشروعي المفضل that would work.
rows.why: The noun with the owner ending (مشروعي) is definite so it takes المفضل; bare مشروع + المفضل is wrong, Amal says No and gives the right form; he later says المشروع المفضل عندي right.

rows.medi_said: ربيعي. ربيعي؟ ... ربيع؟
rows.why: Amal offers 'or if it's Fall' and he answers ربيعي then ربيع (spring); she says No, ربيع is spring, and he gets خريف (sheet: autumn / fall | خريف).

rows.medi_said: قبل ما يخلص. ... إذا ما يخل...
rows.why: حرب is feminine (Amal's earlier point) so the verb must be feminine تخلص; he used the masculine يخلص, Amal prompts with ما؟ / الحرب؟ and he says ما تخلص الحرب.

rows.medi_said: So mid-- Are you saying mid-shadja, right?
rows.amal_said: لا، لا motivation the thing. مش adjective.
rows.why: Review quiz for the noun 'motivation'; he answers the adjective متشجع, Amal says no, the thing not the adjective (sheet: incentive / motivation | 7aafez; motive | Daafe3).

rows.medi_said: qulyan. This is also in general ... We say qulyan for in general.
rows.amal_said: No, it's like completely, fully هيك. ... لا، كليًا is like completely.
rows.why: Asked what كليًا means he says 'in general'; Amal says no, it means completely or fully (in general is بشكل عام).

rows.medi_said: khut tat meni, khut tat meni. Yeah, the sign is good.
rows.why: 'The plan is good' needs el- on the plan and the feminine منيحة; he said khuttat meni and Amal recasts الخطة منيحة, he repeats El khuttat menia.

rows.medi_said: Um, darib.
rows.why: In the end review he answers 'tax' with masculine darib again after Amal made him feminize it at 48:05 (sheet: tax | Dareebe); Amal says mm-hmm and moves on.

rows.medi_said: ما عارفت، عارفت، عارفت.
rows.amal_said: You don't have daylight saving time؟
rows.why: He seems to say 'I didn't know' with an active participle plus a past ending (عارفت); the past would be ما عرفت (or ما كنت عارف); Amal does not react.

rows.medi_said: ما، ما بنوّف... نوّف شغلنا
rows.amal_said: ما want. ... ما راح نوقف شغلنا
rows.why: He tries 'we won't stop our work' with ما بنوقف (b- present) and Amal finishes it as ما راح نوقف شغلنا (future with راح, no b-); chat later types the same.
